headline: Small SE with some period — clean glassy morning, then cross junk.
today: Waist-high SE reaching up to 8s, and the dawn/morning WNW-to-ENE is light so it'll be clean and glassy early. Afternoon goes SSE cross-on and falls apart. Morning session on a log or groveler, aim for the tide push toward the 8:22 high.

daysToWatch.note: Better size at 2-2.6ft with longer-period SE, though N wind runs cross so it won't be pristine. Fun enough on a shortboard early.
S swell at a poor angle for the inlet despite offshore W wind in the afternoon. Wrong direction, expect weak and closed-out.
